narrative.intro: Brookhaven Science Associates has $842M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Brookhaven Science Associates received 2 awards so far this fiscal year, with an average award size of $421M, and obligations are up 1.0% year over year. Department of Energy is the primary buyer, obligating $842M. National Aeronautics and Space Administration is a secondary buyer, obligating $16K. Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Biotechnology) is the dominant market, with $842M in obligations. Research and Development in the Physical, Engineering, and Life Sciences (except Nanotechnology and Biotechnology) registers $16K. Brookhaven Science Associates' fiscal-year obligations have tracked as follows: FY21 $668M, FY22 $951M, FY23 $789M, FY24 $797M, FY25 $834M, and FY26 $842M. These numbers are contract obligations unless noted otherwise for award-value tables, and current-year totals are partial, covering the fiscal year to date. This snapshot shows where Brookhaven Science Associates' federal revenue is concentrated by agency and by market so far in FY2026.

sections.heading: Who are Brookhaven Science Associates' top buyers this year?
sections.body: Department of Energy is the top buyer, obligating $842M. National Aeronautics and Space Administration is a secondary buyer, obligating $16K. The buying pattern shows a heavy concentration with a single agency.

sections.heading: How have Brookhaven Science Associates' federal obligations changed over recent years?
sections.body: FY21 obligations were $668M and rose to $951M in FY22. FY23 obligations were $789M, FY24 obligations were $797M, FY25 obligations were $834M, and FY26 obligations are $842M. Overall obligations are up 1.0% year over year for the current fiscal-year-to-date period.
